title: FlyLo authority map
summary: FlyLo composes separate airline authorities rather than allowing UI or model prose to transact. Journey/Inventory owns route, fare and seat facts; Booking owns booking and ancillary servicing; Operations owns operational status; Payment owns authorisation/capture; Accounting consumes normalized capture evidence; Wire UI projects server-owned state; Grok handles structured language only.

authorities.Journey/Inventory: authoritative route construction, fare revalidation and seat capacity/commitment
authorities.Booking: booking identity, confirmation, passenger identities and ancillary servicing
authorities.Operations: flight operational status and disruption facts
authorities.Accounting: independent accounting.event processing and durable book; never invents booking/payment facts
authorities.Wire UI: authoritative presentation/workspace revisions and semantic action validation; not business authority
authorities.Grok: strict structured interpretation/response planning; proposal/conversation only, never transaction authority
authorities.AS400 boundary: production host boundary remains explicit; development fixtures are not silently relabelled as production

provenance.claim: Accounting, booking, Wire UI and Grok authority boundaries.
